---
title: "Configuration"
description: "Configure schema loading, retrieval and optional credentials in metasalmonpy."
execute:
  eval: false
---

Settings are read at call time. Importing the package does not set environment
variables or supply credentials. Environment settings do not request a model
call. Model assessment of semantic suggestions requires `llm_assess=True`
(and `seed_semantics=True` in `infer_dictionary()`). `chat_decomposition()` has a
separate opt-in path through `chat_provider=` or `chat_request_fn=`. The S16 plan
removes these in-package provider paths in 0.7.0; this page describes their
current controls.

## SDP schema

| Setting | Meaning and precedence |
| --- | --- |
| `METASALMONPY_SDP_SCHEMA_SOURCE` | `auto` (default) tries the pinned remote bundle then the vendored copy; `remote` requires remote loading; `vendored` stays offline. |
| `METASALMONPY_SDP_SCHEMA_BASE_URL` | Select a different schema bundle base URL; unset uses the package's current pinned release. |
| `set_sdp_schema_source()` | Process override ahead of the source environment variable. Pass `None` to restore environment/default resolution. |
| `set_sdp_schema_base_url()` | Process override ahead of the base-URL environment variable. Pass `None` to restore environment/default resolution. |

```python
from metasalmonpy.sdp_schema import set_sdp_schema_source

set_sdp_schema_source("vendored")  # Read the bundled schema offline.
set_sdp_schema_source(None)        # Restore environment/default resolution.
```

Changing either process override clears the schema cache. Package creation,
metadata review and setters use the selected schema. The default schema pin
is maintained with the vendored bundle when a later spec release is implemented.

## Retrieval

| Environment variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `METASALMONPY_CACHE` | Enable the process-local term-result cache with `1`, `true` or `yes`; unset/empty disables it. |
| `METASALMONPY_DEBUG_FETCH` | Enable retrieval diagnostics with `1`, `true` or `yes`; unset/empty disables them. |
| `SALMONPY_CACHE`, `SALMONPY_DEBUG_FETCH` | Deprecated pre-rename fallbacks, consulted only when the corresponding current spelling is unset/empty. Each emits one `DeprecationWarning` per process (which Python may filter by default); both remain supported here. |
| `BIOPORTAL_APIKEY` | BioPortal credential. The first BioPortal search without a key emits one `RuntimeWarning` per process and returns an empty BioPortal result. |

BioPortal warning bookkeeping is private module state. Session identifier generation
uses UUIDs without consuming Python's statistical random stream. The R companion's configuration topic is `?metasalmon_configuration`;
its `metasalmon.*` options and `METASALMON_*` retrieval knobs are R controls.

## GitHub and DataONE

A nonempty `token=` argument takes precedence for GitHub readers. Otherwise,
token discovery checks `GITHUB_PAT`, then `GH_TOKEN`, then the Git credential
helper. See [GitHub data access](github-access.qmd) for the existing setup and
read helpers.

DataONE credentials are process-local, separate for each publication environment:

```python
from metasalmonpy.knb_publication import (
    set_dataone_token,
    set_dataone_test_token,
)
```

Supply a short-lived token through the appropriate setter when making an
explicitly requested deposit. Production and test credentials do not substitute
for each other, and tokens are never written to a package manifest. Passing
`None` clears that environment's process-local credential.

## Optional in-package model provider path

Model assessment of semantic suggestions selects a provider with `llm_provider`
(`openai` by default);
explicit `llm_model`, `llm_base_url` and `llm_api_key` arguments take precedence.
`chat_decomposition()` uses the corresponding `chat_provider`, `chat_model`,
`chat_base_url` and `chat_api_key` arguments. Both paths use the provider-specific
fallbacks below when a call is explicitly requested. Setting an environment
variable alone does not opt in.

| Provider | Model fallback | Endpoint fallback | Credential fallback |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `openai` | `OPENAI_MODEL` | `OPENAI_BASE_URL` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| `openrouter` | `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` |
| `openai_compatible` | `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL` | `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL` | `METASALMON_LLM_API_KEY` |
| `chapi` | `CHAPI_MODEL` | `CHAPI_BASE_URL` | `CHAPI_API_KEY` |

An unset model or endpoint falls back to that provider's package preset where
one exists. `openai_compatible` has no preset: a network call requires a model,
endpoint and credential. An injected `llm_request_fn` or `chat_request_fn`
replaces the network request and does not require an endpoint or credential.
Semantic review accepts an explicit `llm_reasoning_effort`;
`chat_decomposition()` does not have a reasoning-effort argument.

Follow the [semantic review guide](semantic-review.qmd) for the explicit review
flow. The configuration above supplies inputs to existing calls; it never
applies or approves an ontology term.
